title: TRIA QWA data schema for cell measurements
description: Schema for cell-level measurements in a QWA dataset

image_label.title: Image label
image_label.description: Identifying code for the image; join key to QWAimages

year.title: Year
year.description: Ring affiliation (calendar year of cell formation)

xpix.title: X coordinate (pixel)
xpix.description: Cell center x coordinate in the image

ypix.title: Y coordinate (pixel)
ypix.description: Cell center y coordinate in the image

raddistr.title: Radial distance
raddistr.description: Radial distance of cell center from inner ring boundary

rraddistr.title: Relative radial distance
rraddistr.description: Relative radial position of cell center within annual ring (0 = at proximal boundary, 99.99 = at distal boundary)

nbrno.title: Neighbour count
nbrno.description: Number of cells in the group the target cell is part of

nbrid.title: Neighbour group ID
nbrid.description: ID of all cells belonging to the same group as target cell (remains blank if target cell is solitary)

asp.title: Aspect ratio
asp.description: Aspect of cell: Ratio between major axis and minor axis of ellipse equivalent to object

majax.title: Major axis deviation
majax.description: Absolute angular deviation of major cell axis from line towards the X/Y origin

kh.title: Hydraulic conductivity
kh.description: Theoretical hydraulic conductivity [m4*s-1*MPa-1] as approximated by Poiseuille's law and adjusted to elliptical tubes

cwtpi.title: CWT pith side
cwtpi.description: Cell wall thickness on the inner (pith) side

cwtba.title: CWT bark side
cwtba.description: Cell wall thickness on the bark side

cwtle.title: Left CWT
cwtle.description: Cell wall thickness on the left tangential side (ROXAS: viewed from pith, ROXAS AI: as viewed in image)

cwtri.title: Right CWT
cwtri.description: Cell wall thickness on the right tangential side (ROXAS: viewed from pith, ROXAS AI: as viewed in image)

cwttan.title: Tangential CWT
cwttan.description: Mean tangential cell wall thickness ((cwtle + cwtri) / 2)

cwtrad.title: Radial CWT
cwtrad.description: Mean radial cell wall thickness ((cwtpi + cwtba) / 2)

cwtall.title: CWT mean
cwtall.description: Mean of all four cell wall thicknesses.

ctsr.title: Circular thickness-to-span ratio
ctsr.description: Circular thickness-to-span ratio: ratio between 4x single cell wall thickness (CWTall) and tracheid diameter (assuming a circle area-equivalent to the lumen area)

dh.title: Hydraulic diameter
dh.description: Hydraulic diameter of cell (i.e. correcting for effect of elliptical shape on flow)

drad.title: Radial lumen diameter
drad.description: Radial cell lumen diameter (measured in bark-to-pith direction, but corrected for ring inclination)

dtan.title: Tangential lumen diameter
dtan.description: Tangential cell lumen diameter (measured tangentially to pith, but corrected for ring inclination)

tb2.title: Cell wall reinforcement
tb2.description: Cell wall reinforcement index ((t/b)², t is the double cell wall thickness and b the length of the same cell wall; the smaller of the radial or tangential values is selected)

cwa.title: Cell wall area
cwa.description: Cross-sectional area of the cell wall.

rwd2.title: CWT-to-lumen ratio (radial)
rwd2.description: Ratio of radial CWT to radial lumen diameter (cwtrad / drad).

dcwt.title: Cell wall density fraction
dcwt.description: Fraction of total cell area occupied by cell wall (cwa / tca).

cwtall_adj.title: Adjusted mean CWT
cwtall_adj.description: cwttan for earlywood-like cells (rtsr < 1), cwtall otherwise.

cdrad.title: Total radial cell diameter
cdrad.description: Total radial cell diameter including walls (drad + 2 * cwttan).

cdtan.title: Total tangential cell diameter
cdtan.description: Total tangential cell diameter including walls (dtan + 2 * cwtrad).

cdratio.title: Cell diameter ratio
cdratio.description: Ratio of total radial to total tangential cell diameter (cdrad / cdtan).

sector100.title: Sector (1–100)
sector100.description: Radial position bin in a 100-sector division of the ring width

ew_lw.title: Earlywood / latewood
ew_lw.description: Earlywood or latewood classification based on Mork's index
